about.seoTitle: About Branding Supply — personal brand advice in a conversation, from a team of brand experts
about.seoDescription: Branding Supply builds brand foundations in a conversation: purpose, values, archetype, voice — reasoned, written down, ready to ship. Who we are, what we believe, how we work.
about.title: We are our own proof.
about.intro1: We exist because good branding is too often either too expensive or reduced to a template. We believe every brand is a fingerprint — and the way there can be guided, reasoned and measured.
about.intro2: So we applied our products to ourselves first: the name, the fingerprint, this color world, this page — all of it came out of the Brand Wizard, our Visual DNA and our own playbook. Scored by Ada, naturally.
about.fingerprint: Branding Supply · The Sage · rest Creator — style: minimal · editorial — visual DNA: contemporary · geometric · monochrome + acid pop · spacious · digital-clean · precise
about.heroImage: A sheet of heavy paper carrying the Branding Supply brand fingerprint, a single acid-green dot beside it
about.whyTitle: Good branding used to be a choice between expensive and generic.
about.whyAgencyBody: Asks the right questions, thinks strategically, gives reasons — and costs five figures, takes months and stays out of reach for most founders.
about.whyGeneratorBody: Delivers in seconds — a template. No follow-up question, no reasoning, none of the one sentence only you can say.
about.whyUsBody: Asks like an agency, answers like an advisor, works at the pace of a conversation. Every decision reasoned, every decision written down — and the brand stays yours.
about.whyImage: Three objects side by side: a heavy agency folder, a plastic stencil and a small speaker with an acid-green accent
about.principlesTitle: Three principles everything is measured against.
about.p1Body: Every recommendation carries its why. A decision you cannot retrace is not one — so your brand advisor explains instead of announcing, and every reason is written down.
about.p2Body: Your brand advisor asks, proposes, sometimes pushes back — but nothing is confirmed without you. A chapter only closes when you say it fits. The brand stays yours.
about.p3Body: What you share in the conversation becomes brand foundation — not training material. Brand content only ever goes to AI providers that do not retain it; where that is not guaranteed, the job does not run.
about.howTitle: From the first sentence to a foundation that holds.
about.howLead: Your brand foundation stands after roughly 45 minutes of conversation — pause any time, your progress is saved.
about.h1Body: Your brand advisor asks the questions a good agency would ask — one at a time, digging deeper where an answer is thin. “I don’t know” is a legitimate answer.
about.h1Image: Two chairs facing each other across a small table, seen from above, monochrome with a single acid-green dot
about.h2Body: Your answers become drafts: purpose, values, archetype, voice. You confirm or revise — nothing is adopted silently, and contradictions get named instead of smoothed over.
about.h2Image: A stack of index cards, one card lifted and lit, with an acid-green edge
about.h3Body: What is decided lives in your brand document: readable, reasoned, in your language. The foundation that design, copy and everything after builds on.
about.h3Image: A closed, bound document with a thin acid-green ribbon bookmark
about.proofTitle: This page came out of the Wizard.
about.proofBody: Name, fingerprint, color world, voice — everything here was made with the same tools you use. No agency, no template: one conversation, one document, one brand. Scored by Ada, naturally.
about.proofImage: The Branding Supply brand fingerprint as a geometric, monochrome poster on a wall
about.faqTitle: What you want to know before you start.
about.faq1A: Founders, small teams and companies ahead of a relaunch — anyone who needs a solid brand foundation before design and communication begin.
about.faq2A: The foundation — context, purpose, values, archetype and voice — stands after roughly 45 minutes of conversation. Pause any time; your progress is saved.
about.faq3A: No — it replaces the expensive part before one. Design, campaigns and execution build on the foundation; agencies and designers work faster with it and without guesswork.
about.faq4A: It becomes brand foundation, not training material. Brand content only ever goes to AI providers that do not retain it — where that is not guaranteed, the job does not run.
about.faq5A: Nothing during the closed beta. The foundation stays free afterwards, too — you only pay for what is derived from it: design, brand book, kit.
about.faq6A: George is your personal brand advisor — the one contact who holds the thread, from the first question to the document. Behind him works a team of brand experts with clear responsibilities.
about.teamTeaserBody: Your brand advisor leads the conversation — behind him, every task is taken by the brand expert who does it best.

team.teamTitle: The right team member for every task.
team.teamIntro: We break your project into tasks — and each one is taken by the brand expert who does it best. Seven roles, clear boundaries, one shared memory.
team.crewTitle: Your brand advisor speaks — the expert team stands behind him.
team.crewIntro: You have ONE conversation, from the first question to the finished document: your brand advisor George stays your counterpart in every chapter. What changes is the way he asks — he borrows the view of the specialists he went through the chapter with, and he tells you whose view it is.
team.ctaText: The team is ready — your brand advisor asks the first question.
team.seoTitle: The Branding Supply team — your brand advisor and seven brand experts
team.seoDescription: Your personal brand advisor leads the conversation, a team of brand experts takes each task: strategy, design, brand book, content, monitoring, score, benchmark. Who does what for your brand.
team.georgeTitle: George, your brand advisor, holds the thread.
team.georgeBody: He asks the questions a good agency would ask, backs every recommendation and writes every decision down. Design belongs to Frida; when it comes to names, Otto takes over — the thread he never lets go of.
team.georgeImage: Portrait of a calm brand advisor against a neutral grey backdrop, monochrome with one acid-green detail on the lapel
team.teamImage: The seven-person team in a bright studio, monochrome, one acid-green accent
team.flowLead: Nobody on the team works in the dark: every role builds on what was decided before it.
team.flow1Body: Your brand advisor George leads the conversation; Vera, Milo, Nika and Otto take their chapters. At the end stands the brand document.
team.flow2Body: Frida translates the foundation into visual DNA and three directions — strategy becomes visible before a logo exists.
team.flow3Body: Rex gets what was decided ready to ship: brand book, tokens, brand.json, press kit — nothing new, all of it usable.
team.flow4Body: Kira takes the brand into the world, Wanda watches its outside image, Ada computes the score, Scout keeps an eye on the market.
team.flowImage: Four objects in a row: notebook, colour swatch fan, bound book, antenna — joined by an acid-green thread

lead.title: Secure your spot in the beta.
lead.body: We open access in waves. Sign up — we will get in touch as soon as your spot is ready. Already have a code? Redeem it right away.

overview.seoTitle: Products — five steps from audit to delivery
overview.seoDescription: Brand Check, Brand Foundation, Market Comparison, Brand Design, Brand Book & Kit: audit, compare, build, supply. Five products, one brand document.
overview.title: Audit, compare, build, supply.
overview.lead: Five products, one brand document. Each one builds on the last — start at the front and stop wherever it is enough for you.
overview.ctaTitle: Start with what you need today.
overview.ctaBody: The Brand Check is free and needs no account. Everything else we discuss in a first call.

brandCheck.seoTitle: Brand Check — your presence scored against 40 criteria
brandCheck.seoDescription: We read your home page and score it against 40 criteria in eight categories: score, findings, a shareable result. Free, no account.
brandCheck.title: Brand-Check
brandCheck.short: 40 criteria, eight categories — your presence gets a number and findings, in under a minute.
brandCheck.lead: We read your home page — exactly what every visitor sees — and score it against 40 criteria in eight categories.
brandCheck.get1Body: 40 criteria in eight categories: distinctiveness, visual identity, consistency, brand experience, positioning and clarity, emotional impact, adaptability, craft.
brandCheck.get2Body: For every category you read what carries and what is missing — in sentences you can work with the next day.
brandCheck.get3Body: The result has its own address. It only enters the public ranking if you tick the box.
brandCheck.get4Body: How we score, what we fetch and what we leave out is written down on the method page.
brandCheck.how1Body: Your website, written the way you type it into a browser. No account, no sign-up.
brandCheck.how2Body: The home page only, the public part only. A site that forbids automated evaluation is not scored.
brandCheck.how3Body: Under a minute later the result is there — including how it compares to the field.
brandCheck.proofTitle: See what comes out of it.
brandCheck.proofBody: The public ranking lists the presences that were released for it — with score and categories. That is exactly the view you get for your own address.

brandFoundation.seoTitle: Brand Foundation — your brand fundamentals in about 45 minutes
brandFoundation.seoDescription: Purpose, values, archetype, voice and manifesto: your brand consultant walks you through every decision, with reasoning. Free in the closed beta.
brandFoundation.title: Brand Foundation
brandFoundation.short: Purpose, values, archetype, voice, manifesto — decided in conversation and written down with reasons.
brandFoundation.lead: The fundamentals of your brand. Your brand consultant asks the questions, you confirm field by field — in about 45 minutes it stands.
brandFoundation.get1Title: A document, not a slide deck
brandFoundation.get1Body: Every chapter as a reading view, printable — from positioning to the rules for AI-written copy.
brandFoundation.get2Body: You see why a proposal looks the way it does, and you confirm it field by field. Nothing is in there that you have not signed off.
brandFoundation.get3Body: You pick the content language when you create the branding, and it stays. A half-German, half-English manifesto would not be a result.
brandFoundation.get4Title: The base for everything after it
brandFoundation.get4Body: Market Comparison and Brand Design build on it. The Foundation is the part that stays free.
brandFoundation.how1Body: Industry, goals, competitors — your brand consultant reads up before asking.
brandFoundation.how2Body: Questions first, conclusions after. You confirm, correct, or ask for a new proposal.
brandFoundation.how3Title: Read it, print it, work with it
brandFoundation.how3Body: At the end there is the reading view of your branding — shareable and printable.
brandFoundation.proofTitle: A finished foundation to look at.
brandFoundation.proofBody: Kailua Coffee Co. is an example branding, rendered by the same renderer as every real one. This is what a signed-off foundation looks like.
brandFoundation.price: Free — in the closed beta by invitation or from the waiting list.
brandFoundation.requirement: an account, by invite code or from the waiting list.

marketComparison.seoTitle: Market Comparison — what your competitors claim, in the same grid
marketComparison.seoDescription: Your Brand Foundation next to what competitors publicly say: field by field, every statement with a quote and its source. {price} net per branding, one-off.
marketComparison.title: Market Comparison
marketComparison.short: Your foundation next to what competitors publicly say — field by field, with quote and source.
marketComparison.lead: We put your Brand Foundation next to what competitors publicly say — field by field, every statement with a quote and its source.
marketComparison.cta: Discuss it in a first call
marketComparison.get1Body: Competitors are described in the same field structure as your own foundation. Only then can anything be compared at all.
marketComparison.get2Body: Every row carries its quote and the source it came from. What cannot be evidenced does not enter the report.
marketComparison.get3Body: Where you differ, where everyone says the same thing — and which claim nobody in the field has taken.
marketComparison.get4Body: Three runs per branding per day; a run on an unchanged state uses none of them.
marketComparison.how1Body: You say who is in the field. Suggestions come on top, the choice stays yours.
marketComparison.how2Body: We read what the competitors publish themselves and pull statements from it, with quote and source.
marketComparison.how3Body: The report puts your statement next to theirs, in the same order as your foundation.
marketComparison.proofTitle: How we read is written down.
marketComparison.proofBody: The Market Comparison reads other people's presences. That is why the method page says what we fetch, what we leave out and how you can object. In Discover Brands you see what a finished brand looks like here.
marketComparison.price: {price} net per branding, one-off — plus VAT. Beta accounts use it for free; buying it follows, until then by first call.

brandDesign.seoTitle: Brand Design — colour, type and marks derived from your foundation
brandDesign.seoDescription: The Brand Foundation becomes a look: light and dark colour with checked contrast pairs, typography, marks, imagery, motion. Studio-guided.
brandDesign.title: Brand Design
brandDesign.short: Colour, typography, marks, imagery, motion — derived from your foundation, not guessed.
brandDesign.lead: Your foundation becomes a look: colour, typography, marks, imagery and motion — every decision with its reasoning.
brandDesign.cta: Discuss it in a first call
brandDesign.get1Body: One base colour, two complete ramps and contrast pairs with a verdict — what is not readable is not proposed.
brandDesign.get2Body: Type pairing, scale, hierarchy — and the rule for what each typeface is there for.
brandDesign.get3Body: Word and picture marks as drafts, imagery principles instead of stock smiles, timing and easing including reduced motion.
brandDesign.get4Body: At the end there is the result board of your brand, and the visual identity chapter of your foundation is full.
brandDesign.how1Body: Archetype, values and voice decide which directions are on the table at all.
brandDesign.how2Body: Colour, typography, marks, imagery, motion — with proposals you accept, change or reject.
brandDesign.how3Title: Sign it off and hand it on
brandDesign.how3Body: The signed-off board is the template for Brand Book & Kit.
brandDesign.proofTitle: This is what finished brands look like here.
brandDesign.proofBody: Discover Brands lists the brandings whose owners made them public — with colour, type and marks.
brandDesign.price: Studio-guided: unlocked per brand after the first call.

brandBookKit.seoTitle: Brand Book & Kit — your brand manual and the files that go with it
brandBookKit.seoDescription: Brand book, design tokens for light and dark, brand.json and Brand Context for AI, press kit. Included in the one-off price of the derivation.
brandBookKit.title: Brand Book & Kit
brandBookKit.short: Everything decided, ready to ship: manual, design tokens, brand.json and press kit.
brandBookKit.priceShort: Included in the one-off price of the derivation.
brandBookKit.lead: The delivery: the brand book as a manual, the design tokens, brand.json and Brand Context for AI, plus the press kit. Nothing new is decided — everything becomes usable.
brandBookKit.cta: Discuss it in a first call
brandBookKit.get1Body: The manual for your brand: rules for applying marks and colours, do and don't, worked examples.
brandBookKit.get2Body: The same names in both modes, checked contrast pairs — as CSS and for Tailwind.
brandBookKit.get3Body: brand.json and brand.md, the Brand Context: the thing you hand to any AI tool.
brandBookKit.get4Body: The mark in its variants, boilerplate in three lengths, the facts — ready to send.
brandBookKit.how1Body: Purpose, values, archetype and voice are decided and signed off.
brandBookKit.how2Body: Colour, typography, marks, imagery and motion are in place.
brandBookKit.how3Body: We curate and export — nothing new, everything usable.
brandBookKit.proofTitle: You can see the step before it today.
brandBookKit.proofBody: Book and Kit ship what Brand Design decided. If you want to know what ends up in the manual, look at the stage before it.
brandBookKit.price: Coming — included in the one-off price of the derivation ({price} net per branding).
brandBookKit.requirement: a signed-off Brand Foundation and Brand Design.
